general.title: General
general.description: Configure your Backspace instance. These settings affect all users.

instanceName.label: Instance Name
instanceName.description: The name shown on the login page and to federated instances.

discovery.label: Discovery
discovery.toggleDescription: Allow spaces to appear in the public Explore page

gif.label: GIF Search
gif.description: Enable GIF search powered by Klipy. Get a free API key from the Klipy developer portal.
gif.placeholderSaved: Key saved — enter new key to replace

registration.title: Registration
registration.description: Control who can create accounts on this instance. Public registration covers local sign-ups; federated registration covers users from peered instances creating an account here.

public.label: Public Registration
public.toggleDescription: Anyone can create a local account from the registration page. When off, only invite links can create new local accounts.

federated.label: Federated Registration
federated.toggleDescription: Users from other instances can create a federated account here via their Connections settings. Existing federated accounts can always log in regardless of this setting.

invites.label: Invite Links
invites.noMatch: No invites match the current filter.

form.name: Name
form.maxUsesInteger: Max uses must be a positive integer

createModal.title: Create invite link
createModal.description: Generate a shareable link that lets people register on this instance. You'll set how many times it can be used and when it expires.
createModal.createdManual: Link created. Copy manually from the row.

editModal.title: Edit "{{name}}"
editModal.description: Adjust the limits on this invite link. The URL stays the same — anyone who already has it can still redeem under the new constraints.
editModal.maxUsesBelowUsed: Max uses cannot be less than current uses ({{used}})

reinstateModal.title: Reinstate "{{name}}"
reinstateModal.descriptionRevoked: This invite was revoked. Reinstating generates a new link with a different URL — the old URL stays inactive.
reinstateModal.descriptionLapsed: This invite has lapsed. Reinstating reactivates the same URL — anyone who saved it will be able to use it again.
reinstateModal.newLinkWarning: A new link will be generated. Anyone who had the old URL will not be able to use it.
reinstateModal.maxUsesMin: Max uses must be at least {{min}} (current uses: {{used}})
reinstateModal.doneCopied: Reinstated with new link. Copied to clipboard.
reinstateModal.doneManual: Reinstated with new link. Copy manually from the row.
reinstateModal.doneSameLink: Reinstated. The same link is active again.

redemptions.title: Redemptions for "{{name}}"
redemptions.description: Users who registered using this invite link, in the order they signed up.
redemptions.revokedNotice: This invite was revoked. The redemptions below represent users who registered before revocation.
redemptions.revokedNoticeDated: This invite was revoked {{date}}. The redemptions below represent users who registered before revocation.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke "{{name}}"?
revokeDialog.description:
The link stops working immediately. Anyone who has the URL can no longer use it.

If you change your mind later, Reinstate issues a fresh link under this entry — the original URL stays inactive.

deleteDialog.title: Delete "{{name}}" permanently?
deleteDialog.description: This cannot be undone. Redemption history for this link will also be removed. If you only want to stop the link from working, use Revoke instead — that preserves the redemption record.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Monitor disk usage and clean up orphaned files left behind by deleted content or replaced avatars/banners.

cleanup.label: Cleanup
cleanup.nothingFound: No orphaned files, stale uploads, or dangling records found.

stale.label: Stale Uploads
stale.description: Abandoned tus upload sessions in .tus/ (paused/crashed without DELETE). Auto-expire runs every 24 hours; this lets you sweep proactively.

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.description: These limits apply to all users on this instance. Users can pick values within these bounds.

bandwidth.label: Bandwidth
bandwidth.description: Minimum and maximum bitrate bounds, and the step size for the quality slider.

customBitrate.label: Allow Custom Bitrate
customBitrate.description: Let users set their own bitrate instead of using the matrix defaults

quality.label: Quality
quality.description: Available resolution and frame rate options for screen sharing.

highEndWarning.title: High-performance settings enabled.
highEndWarning.description: Streaming above 1080p or 60 fps requires significant client-side CPU/GPU encoding power and can saturate server bandwidth, especially when streams are routed through TURN. High-end configurations (e.g., 4K at 120 fps) can require up to 45 Mbps per active stream. Ensure your infrastructure can handle this load before enabling these options for all users.

matrix.label: Bitrate Matrix
matrix.description: Default bitrates per resolution and frame rate. Edit individual cells or scale all values at once.
matrix.scaleHint: Drag to scale all bitrates. Fine-tune individual cells below.

capWarning.title: Matrix values exceed global cap.
capWarning.description: Some bitrate values exceed your maximum of {{max}}. Streams at those combos will be quality-degraded to your cap.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: What this instance is running, and how to move it forward.
updates.loadFailed: Could not load the update status.
updates.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the command and copy it by hand.

available.label: Available
available.scriptDescription: Takes a database snapshot, fetches the new image, and restarts only the Backspace container. If the new version does not come up healthy, or comes up still running the old code, it puts back the version you are on now.
available.manualIntro: update.sh ships from 1.0.5 onward. On a git checkout, git pull brings it in. Otherwise run the steps by hand, after taking a snapshot with ./backup.sh.
available.manualWarning: Name the backspace service explicitly and do not pass --remove-orphans. Compose will suggest it if you run other containers in this project, and it would delete them.

updates.upToDate: You are on the latest release.

disabled.title: Update checks are turned off
disabled.description: This instance will not contact GitHub. Set BACKSPACE_UPDATE_CHECK=true in your .env to allow the lookup, or check the releases page yourself.

rateLimited.title: GitHub rate-limited the lookup
rateLimited.description: This says nothing about whether an update exists. Try again later.

unreachable.title: Could not check for updates
unreachable.description: GitHub could not be reached, so this says nothing about whether an update exists. Your instance is unaffected.

users.title: Users
users.description: View and manage user accounts on this instance.

actions.federatedNoReset: Federated users authenticate via home instance
actions.selfDelete: Use account settings to delete your own account

tempPassword.label: Temporary password:
tempPassword.note: Shown once. User has been disconnected and must log in again.

resetDialog.title: Reset Password
resetDialog.description: Reset the password for {{username}}? They will be disconnected immediately and must log in with the new temporary password.

demoteDialog.title: Demote Admin
demoteDialog.description: Remove admin privileges from {{username}}? They will lose access to instance settings.

deleteDialog.title: Delete User
deleteDialog.description: Permanently delete {{username}}? This will remove them from all spaces, DMs, and friends lists. This cannot be undone.
